title: #[forbid(unsafe_code)] at crate root — non-negotiable
description: A JMAP client does I/O, processes untrusted server data, and is used in async context. #[forbid(unsafe_code)] eliminates an entire class of soundness bugs. A future contributor adding a fast path for SIMD parsing or zero-copy buffer manipulation will suggest removing this. Do not. The performance upside of unsafe in this crate is near zero; the risk is not.
